title: fleet repository row
description: One line of repos.jsonl written by skills/fleet/scripts/fleet.py. A failed row has a reason token and null signals_schema_version, scans and active. An ok row's active says whether its HEAD was committed inside the run's window. Generated from lib/fleet.py by lib/fleet_schema.py.

reason.description: Why the block is unavailable: a sentence, or 'code: sentence' for a block whose codes are listed under its own entry. A counts-only document keeps only the leading code, or unavailable when the reason has no code.

review_automation.description: AI review in CI (lib/review_automation.py): present is true when a git-tracked CI step, GitLab component or include, or AI review app config runs an AI review; kinds names which (ci_action, ci_component, config_file).

reason.description: Why the block is unavailable. A counts-only document keeps only the leading code, or unavailable when the reason has no code.

ai_usage.description: Agent involvement in the commits of the run window (lib/ai_usage.py), counted from git history. An agent identity is matched by trailer (Co-Authored-By and similar) or by author against the accounts confirmed in [identities], the pinned agent rules and any [[ai_usage.agent_identities]] rules of --fleet-config. Counts are commits; shares are of total_commits. A lower bound: an agent that leaves no trace is not counted.

window.description: The history window read, for example 6mo.

since.description: The window as an absolute git --since bound (@<epoch>, counted back from HEAD's commit time); dropped in counts-only output.

merge_rule.description: How merge commits are treated (excluded: not counted).

agent_trailer_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of commits carrying an agent trailer; null when nothing was counted.

agent_authored_commits.description: Commits whose author an agent identity matches.

agent_authored_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of commits whose author an agent identity matches; null when nothing was counted.

agent_either_commits.description: Commits with an agent trailer or an agent author.

agent_either_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of commits with an agent trailer or an agent author; null when nothing was counted.

dependency_bot_commits.description: Commits by a dependency-update bot (Dependabot, Renovate); never counted as agent work.

token_user_commits.description: Commits by a GitLab access-token user (project_<id>_bot_<hex>) not promoted to agent; a config rule or token_users_as_agents promotes one.

agent_identity_rule_commits.description: Commits each [[ai_usage.agent_identities]] rule matched, a positional list in rule order; the rule patterns themselves are never written.

identities_awaiting_confirmation.description: Accounts in the window that look automated (a [bot] suffix, a GitLab token user, a bot or AI tool name) and are neither classified in the [identities] config section nor counted by an agent rule (#765). A next step for the human, never a score; the accounts are listed only by scripts/identity_candidates.py.

covered_agents.description: A list of strings; counts-only output keeps only its length.

covered_author_agents.description: A list of strings; counts-only output keeps only its length.

limits.description: A list of strings; counts-only output keeps only its length.

reason.description: Why the block is unavailable. A counts-only document keeps only the leading code, or unavailable when the reason has no code.

ci_checks.description: Does CI run a test or lint check (lib/ci_checks.py), read from the git-tracked CI files and the GitLab includes resolved offline (lib/ci_includes.py: local files, and project or component files of clones in the --ghsync-root). test_or_lint_configured is true when an own or included CI line runs one, false when none does and every include resolved, and null (unknown) when a CI file pulls jobs from a file this run could not read (an unresolved GitLab include, a reusable workflow in another repository); basis says which. Under --platform, a repository with an unresolved GitLab include also gets GitLab's merged configuration from the CI lint API (lib/gitlab_ci_lint.py), counted apart in merged_check_commands; a template resolved offline wins. enforced_check_runs (issue #775) is the same test with masked checks left out (|| true, continue-on-error: true, allow_failure: true, set +e without a re-raise; lib/ci_masking.py) and checks off the ordinary triggers left out (lib/ci_triggers.py); masked_check_commands and off_trigger_check_commands count the lines left out. lint_runs (issue #782) is the enforced test for lint lines only (Layer 3 level 1); a check target or script that may run a linter inside it reads null. Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines, Bitbucket Pipelines, Travis CI and Buildkite files are not parsed (issue #787): unread_ci_files counts them, and with no readable check one makes basis unread_ci_system and enforced_check_runs null (and lint_runs null with no readable lint line).

check_commands.description: CI lines that run a test or lint check.

included_files.description: CI files that pull jobs from elsewhere.

included_check_commands.description: Lines of resolved included files that run a test or lint check.

resolved_includes.description: Include items whose every file was read.

unresolved_includes.description: Include items not read (status other than resolved).

id.description: gitlab_project:<path> or gitlab_component:<path>; null for local, template and remote.

status.description: resolved, or why not: no_root, not_cloned, file_missing, not_offline (template, remote), glob, bad_path, depth_limit, file_limit, unparsed, ref_missing (a pin the clone does not hold).

ref_basis.description: How the file was read: at the pinned ref, at the clone's HEAD (no pin), or from the work tree; null when not resolved.

depth.description: Include level: 1 for the repository's own include.

includes.description: One record per include item, nested includes after their parent; no file name or text.

merged_config.description: The CI lint API read: not_read (offline), not_needed (every include resolved offline), read, invalid (GitLab marked the configuration invalid) or unavailable.

merged_config_reason.description: The reason code when merged_config is unavailable (no_access, not_found, not_gitlab, ...); null otherwise.

merged_check_commands.description: Lines of the merged configuration that run a test or lint check; the text is never published.

test_or_lint_configured.description: The CI test-or-lint signal: true, false, or null when included jobs may hold the check.

basis.description: The reason for test_or_lint_configured: check_command or merged_config (true; the second when only the merged configuration ran a check), included_jobs or merged_config_partial (null; the second when the merged configuration was read with no check but may lack jobs: an include under rules:, or a trigger: child pipeline), unread_ci_system (false: no readable check, but a CI file of a system the scan does not parse is tracked), no_check_command or no_ci (false).

enforced_check_runs.description: Layer 5 level 1: true when a CI line runs a check that can fail its job on ordinary changes, null when none does but included jobs, unsettled triggers or a CI system the scan does not parse may hold one, else false.

enforced_basis.description: The reason for enforced_check_runs: enforced_check (true), included_jobs or unknown_trigger or unread_ci_system (null), not_enforced, no_check_command or no_ci (false).

masked_check_commands.description: CI lines that run a check whose failure cannot fail the job.

off_trigger_check_commands.description: Unmasked CI check lines whose workflow or job does not run on ordinary changes (workflow_dispatch or schedule only, a manual GitLab job).

lint_runs.description: Layer 3 level 1 (issue #782): true when a CI line runs a linter that can fail its job on ordinary changes (not --version or --help), or a step uses a known lint action (golangci-lint-action, ruff-action, super-linter, reviewdog), null when none does but included jobs, unsettled triggers or a check target or script that may lint inside it could hold one, else false.

lint_basis.description: The reason for lint_runs: lint_command (true), included_jobs, merged_config_partial, unknown_trigger, check_target or unread_ci_system (null), not_enforced, no_lint_command or no_ci (false).

unread_ci_files.description: Tracked root CI files of systems the scan does not parse (Jenkinsfile, .circleci/config.yml, azure-pipelines.yml, bitbucket-pipelines.yml, .travis.yml, .buildkite/pipeline.yml, and the Azure and Buildkite .yaml / buildkite.yml spellings).

reason.description: Why the block is unavailable. A counts-only document keeps only the leading code, or unavailable when the reason has no code.

coverage_gate.description: Committed line-coverage thresholds (lib/coverage_gate.py), read from config and CI files at HEAD, never from measured coverage. Each gate keeps its threshold as written beside threshold_percent, the same value as a percentage (a JaCoCo ratio 0.80 is 80).

configured.description: True when any gate gates something (a non-zero threshold, or a null one from a tool default or a templated flag). Read from configuration text at HEAD; was enforced before issue #783.

threshold.description: The threshold as written; null when not read (a template variable, a tool default).

threshold_percent.description: The threshold as a percentage: as written for percent, times 100 for ratio; null for uncovered_count or a threshold not read.

gates.description: Each gate found, with its file and 1-based line.

max_threshold_percent.description: The highest non-null threshold_percent across the gates; null when no gate has one.

threshold_meets_minimum.description: The Layer 6 level 1 signal: true when a counted gate's threshold_percent is at least 50; null (unknown) when none is but a counted gate's percentage was not read, or when no gate is found in a repository holding a go.mod or Cargo.toml (see unmeasured_reason); false otherwise. Gates counted are those enforced counts.

unmeasured_reason.description: Why threshold_meets_minimum is null with no gate found: go_rust_gate_form_not_read when the repository holds a go.mod or Cargo.toml and its gate may be a script this scan does not read; null otherwise.

not_detected.description: A list of strings; counts-only output keeps only its length.

reason.description: Why the block is unavailable. A counts-only document keeps only the leading code, or unavailable when the reason has no code.

delivery.description: How work flows through review to merge (lib/delivery.py), from one shared sample of up to 30 changes merged inside the run window, newest merge first (the sample review_reality reads). A platform block: present only under --platform (absent otherwise); a refused read is available false with a reason (no_access on HTTP 403), never zeros. Durations are hours; shares are of merged_count.

merged_count.description: Merged changes in the sample (at most 30).

time_to_merge_hours_p50.description: Median time from opened to merged, in hours (rounded to 0.01, nearest-rank percentile); null when no sampled change has both timestamps.

time_to_merge_hours_p90.description: 90th percentile time from opened to merged, in hours (rounded to 0.01, nearest-rank percentile); null when no sampled change has both timestamps.

first_human_comment_hours_p50.description: Median time from opened to the first comment or review by a person other than the author (bots and agent identities excluded), in hours (rounded to 0.01, nearest-rank percentile); null when no sampled change has both timestamps.

first_human_comment_hours_p90.description: 90th percentile time from opened to the first human comment or review, in hours (rounded to 0.01, nearest-rank percentile); null when no sampled change has both timestamps.

human_commented_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes with any human comment or review; null when nothing was counted.

ai_review_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes with a review or comment by an AI reviewer other than the author; null when nothing was counted.

approved_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes approved by someone other than the author (copied from review_reality); null when nothing was counted.

self_merged_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes merged by their author (copied from review_reality); null when nothing was counted.

agent_authored_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes an agent identity authored; null when nothing was counted.

reason.description: Why the block is unavailable. A counts-only document keeps only the leading code, or unavailable when the reason has no code.

guardrails.description: Guardrails stated (lib/guardrails.py): the gates the repository configures at HEAD (a ruff or flake8 complexity limit, the coverage floor from coverage_gate, pre-commit hooks, mypy strict) and whether a graded instruction file states each one's rule and threshold on one line.

threshold.description: The limit or floor; null for a gate with none (pre-commit, mypy strict).

stated_in.description: The first instruction file that states the gate.

snippet.description: A ready one-line sentence for an unstated gate; null when stated. Dropped from counts-only output.

gates.description: Each gate found, one per configuring file.

stated.description: Gates a graded instruction file states.

unstated.description: Gates no graded instruction file states.

stated_pct.description: The guardrails-stated row's signal: stated as a percentage of enforced; null when no gate is found.

not_read.description: A list of strings; counts-only output keeps only its length.

reason.description: 'code: sentence'. The codes name the missing piece: no_grimp (grimp, the Python import-graph builder, is not installed); no_networkx (networkx, which the structure metrics need, is not installed); grimp_failed (grimp could not build the Python import graph); no_python_packages (a Python repository with no importable package); no_import_graph_<language> (no import graph builder exists yet for the dominant source language, for example no_import_graph_rust); invalid_import_graph (a builder returned a graph that breaks the module-graph contract); no_source_files (the scope holds no source file in a language the assess skill recognises). A counts-only document keeps only the leading code, or unavailable when the reason has no code.
